title: Confesión de un asesor: la mitad lo vendo por fuera (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 20)

ia.dice: Llevo tres años como asesor inmobiliario. La mitad de los leads que me llegan… los vendo por fuera.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. A small podcast studio with acoustic foam panels, a neon sign that says "PODCAST", and big professional microphones on boom arms. an anonymous real estate agent shown only as a dark silhouette against a bright backlit window, face completely hidden in shadow, wearing a suit, sits in front of a podcast microphone, leaning toward it, speaking slowly and says in Mexican Spanish, low, deep and mysterious, voice slightly distorted like an anonymous interview: "Llevo tres años como asesor inmobiliario. La mitad de los leads que me llegan… los vendo por fuera." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, soft room tone. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: ¿Y tu jefe nunca se ha dado cuenta?
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. A small podcast studio with acoustic foam panels, a neon sign that says "PODCAST", and big professional microphones on boom arms. Daniela, a Mexican podcast host in her thirties with a short black bob, big headphones around her neck and a black t-shirt, sits across the table in front of her own microphone, leans in with wide eyes, shocked and curious and says in Mexican Spanish, shocked, almost whispering: "¿Y tu jefe nunca se ha dado cuenta?" Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only her voice in Spanish, soft room tone. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Mi jefe cree que la publicidad no funciona.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. A small podcast studio with acoustic foam panels, a neon sign that says "PODCAST", and big professional microphones on boom arms. an anonymous real estate agent shown only as a dark silhouette against a bright backlit window, face completely hidden in shadow, wearing a suit, sits in front of a podcast microphone, the silhouette leans back and lets out a short laugh and says in Mexican Spanish, low, deep and mysterious, voice slightly distorted like an anonymous interview, a short laugh at the end: "Mi jefe cree que la publicidad no funciona." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, soft room tone. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Cuando los leads se trabajan en el WhatsApp personal de cada asesor, el dueño culpa a la publicidad. Y el problema está adentro.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
